unit_or_scope: Air India customer queries and refund-workflow trial in India
direct_observation: Company reports about 40000 daily queries across 1300 types; over 13 million conversations resolved at 97% success with 3% human escalation; about half of customers choose human service
closed_stage: service scale human fallback and customer-choice mechanism
missing_stage: correctness reversibility language disability older travellers refund completion equity and remedy
evidence_status: medium for company-reported operation; low for independent user outcomes
next_test: trace sampled booking change and refund cases from intent through escalation correction payment and complaint

source_title: Public Employee Benefits Administrators four-agent workflow
unit_or_scope: PEBA benefits administration shared mailbox and case workflow
direct_observation: Four agents enrich cases draft responses manage knowledge and evaluate quality; 983 cases or conversations evaluated versus about 50 in manual samples; reported resolution time fell 9% and response time 6%
missing_stage: authority per action member notice benefit correctness correction appeal accessibility worker workload and counterfactual staffing
evidence_status: medium for operational metrics; low for member outcomes
next_test: review case logs for wrong records notice human override correction denial appeal and member harm

evidence_status: high for governance design; low for patient outcomes
